ar: سُبْحَانَ ٱللَّٰهِ
tr: SubhanAllah
en: Glory be to Allah

ar: ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّٰهِ
tr: Alhamdulillah
en: All praise is for Allah

ar: ٱللَّٰهُ أَكْبَرُ
tr: Allahu Akbar
en: Allah is the Greatest

ar: لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا ٱللَّٰهُ
tr: La ilaha illallah
en: There is no god but Allah

ar: سُبْحَانَ ٱللَّٰهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ
tr: SubhanAllahi wa bihamdihi
en: Glory and praise be to Allah

ar: سُبْحَانَ ٱللَّٰهِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
tr: SubhanAllahil Azeem
en: Glory be to Allah, the Almighty

ar: أَسْتَغْفِرُ ٱللَّٰهَ
tr: Astaghfirullah
en: I seek forgiveness from Allah

ar: لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِٱللَّٰهِ
tr: La hawla wa la quwwata illa billah
en: There is no power and no strength except with Allah

ar: ٱللَّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ
tr: Allahumma salli ala Muhammad
en: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad

ar: حَسْبُنَا ٱللَّٰهُ وَنِعْمَ ٱلْوَكِيلُ
tr: Hasbunallahu wa ni'mal wakeel
en: Allah is enough for us, and He is the best disposer of affairs

ar: لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا أَنتَ سُبْحَانَكَ إِنِّي كُنتُ مِنَ ٱلظَّالِمِينَ
tr: La ilaha illa anta subhanaka inni kuntu minaz-zalimeen
en: There is no god but You, glory be to You; indeed I have been among the wrongdoers

ar: رَبِّ ٱغْفِرْ لِي وَتُبْ عَلَيَّ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلتَّوَّابُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
tr: Rabbi-ghfir li wa tub alayya innaka antat-tawwabur-raheem
en: My Lord, forgive me and accept my repentance; You are the Accepting of repentance, the Merciful

ar: يَا حَيُّ يَا قَيُّومُ بِرَحْمَتِكَ أَسْتَغِيثُ
tr: Ya Hayyu ya Qayyum, bi-rahmatika astagheeth
en: O Ever-Living, O Sustainer, in Your mercy I seek relief

ar: يَا مُقَلِّبَ ٱلْقُلُوبِ ثَبِّتْ قَلْبِي عَلَىٰ دِينِكَ
tr: Ya muqallibal-quloob, thabbit qalbi ala deenik
en: O Turner of hearts, keep my heart firm upon Your religion

ar: رَبَّنَا آتِنَا فِي ٱلدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَفِي ٱلْآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَقِنَا عَذَابَ ٱلنَّارِ
tr: Rabbana atina fid-dunya hasanatan wa fil-akhirati hasanatan wa qina adhaban-nar
en: Our Lord, give us good in this world and good in the Hereafter, and protect us from the punishment of the Fire

ar: رَّبِّ زِدْنِي عِلْمًا
tr: Rabbi zidni ilma
en: My Lord, increase me in knowledge

ar: إِنَّا لِلَّٰهِ وَإِنَّا إِلَيْهِ رَاجِعُونَ
tr: Inna lillahi wa inna ilayhi raji'oon
en: Indeed we belong to Allah, and indeed to Him we return

ar: مَا شَاءَ ٱللَّٰهُ لَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِٱللَّٰهِ
tr: Ma sha Allah la quwwata illa billah
en: What Allah wills; there is no power except with Allah

ar: ٱللَّٰهُمَّ إِنَّكَ عَفُوٌّ تُحِبُّ ٱلْعَفْوَ فَٱعْفُ عَنِّي
tr: Allahumma innaka afuwwun tuhibbul-afwa fa'fu anni
en: O Allah, You are Pardoning and love to pardon, so pardon me

ar: حَسْبِيَ ٱللَّٰهُ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ عَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ وَهُوَ رَبُّ ٱلْعَرْشِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
tr: Hasbiyallahu la ilaha illa huwa alayhi tawakkaltu wa huwa rabbul-arshil-azeem
en: Allah is sufficient for me; there is no god but Him. In Him I put my trust, and He is the Lord of the Mighty Throne

ar: ٱللَّٰهُمَّ أَنتَ ٱلسَّلَامُ وَمِنكَ ٱلسَّلَامُ تَبَارَكْتَ يَا ذَا ٱلْجَلَالِ وَٱلْإِكْرَامِ
tr: Allahumma antas-salam wa minkas-salam, tabarakta ya dhal-jalali wal-ikram
en: O Allah, You are Peace and from You comes peace; blessed are You, O Possessor of majesty and honour

ar: لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا ٱللَّٰهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ ٱلْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ ٱلْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
tr: La ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu wa huwa ala kulli shay'in qadeer
en: There is no god but Allah alone, with no partner. His is the dominion and His is the praise, and He has power over all things

ar: سُبْحَانَ ٱللَّٰهِ وَٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّٰهِ وَلَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا ٱللَّٰهُ وَٱللَّٰهُ أَكْبَرُ
tr: SubhanAllah wal-hamdu lillah wa la ilaha illallah wallahu akbar
en: Glory be to Allah, praise be to Allah, there is no god but Allah, and Allah is the Greatest

ar: رَضِيتُ بِٱللَّٰهِ رَبًّا وَبِٱلْإِسْلَامِ دِينًا وَبِمُحَمَّدٍ نَبِيًّا
tr: Radeetu billahi rabba, wa bil-islami deena, wa bi-Muhammadin nabiyya
en: I am pleased with Allah as my Lord, Islam as my religion, and Muhammad as my Prophet

ar: ٱللَّٰهُمَّ أَعِنِّي عَلَىٰ ذِكْرِكَ وَشُكْرِكَ وَحُسْنِ عِبَادَتِكَ
tr: Allahumma a'inni ala dhikrika wa shukrika wa husni ibadatik
en: O Allah, help me to remember You, to thank You, and to worship You well

ar: بِسْمِ ٱللَّٰهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ
tr: Bismillahir-Rahmanir-Raheem
en: In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful

ar: رَبِّ إِنِّي لِمَا أَنزَلْتَ إِلَيَّ مِنْ خَيْرٍ فَقِيرٌ
tr: Rabbi inni lima anzalta ilayya min khayrin faqeer
en: My Lord, I am in need of whatever good You send down to me
